Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated two different individuals named Roy Mack—the film director and the baseball executive. It treated Washington, D.C. (the baseball executive’s birthplace) as a conflicting birthplace for the director, despite credible sources (IMDb and the Roy Mack (director) Wikipedia page) indicating New Brunswick, New Jersey. This misinterpretation introduced unnecessary confusion and stalled resolution, potentially leading to an incorrect conclusion.
